title: The data of change.offered
description: A cycle left a change for review. Witness: a work line with change, no signalled, and an end other than refused or merged. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

cycle.description: The cycle id, <blueprint>-<attempt>, unique within one store.

end.description: The cycle's end: never refused or merged.

at.description: The end's time, the line's ended.
